name: helical-platform
description: Compute embeddings and fine-tune Helical foundation models — hosted and billed per token, or locally on your own GPU with the open-source package.

interface.longDescription:
Helical lets you run biological foundation models on your own single-cell data, from the chat you're already in.

Upload an .h5ad dataset into your private Helical project, pick a model — scGPT, Geneformer, TranscriptFormer, Cell2Sentence or Nicheformer — and compute embeddings on Helical's GPUs. Follow the run while it goes, read the error if it fails, and download the embeddings when it finishes.

Nothing starts on its own. A run is priced and queued first, and only begins once you approve it in a second, separate step. Every tool works inside the one project your account owns.

Compute is pay-as-you-go. Each model has a published per-cell rate, runs are billed per processed cell, and you top up a prepaid credit balance on helical.bio — no subscription.
